# Fingerboard Lab

> Fingerboard Lab is a specialist online shop for precision-engineered fingerboard (mini finger-skateboard) hardware built for real skating. We sell complete fingerboard setups, hand-pressed maple decks, CNC concave molds, trucks, wheels, bearings, bushings, grip tape, tools, and wooden ramps. Everything is machined to ±0.1mm tolerances. Free sticker sheet in every box, worldwide shipping, and 30-day returns.

## Key facts
- Product categories: Completes & Setups, Decks, Fingerboard Molds, Hardware & Tools, Ramps & Parks.
- Most popular deck width: 34mm (versatile for most riders); 32mm is more technical/nimble; 36mm is wider and more stable.
- Checkout is card payment via Stripe. Currency: USD.
- A "complete" is a ready-to-ride assembled fingerboard (deck + trucks + wheels + grip tape).
- Standard fingerboard decks are 5-ply maple veneer pressed on a concave mold; concave is the curve across the deck's width, camber is the curve along its length.
- Truck width should roughly match deck width; bushing durometer (Shore A) and kingpin nut tightness together control turning looseness vs. stability.

## Shop
- [All products](https://fingerboardlab.com/search): The full catalog of fingerboard gear.
- [Completes & Setups](https://fingerboardlab.com/search/starter-kits): Ready-to-ride assembled fingerboards.
- [Decks](https://fingerboardlab.com/search/decks): Bare maple and graphic fingerboard decks, 32–36mm.
- [Fingerboard Molds](https://fingerboardlab.com/search/concave-molds): CNC concave molds for pressing your own decks.
- [Hardware & Tools](https://fingerboardlab.com/search/accessories): Trucks, wheels, bearings, bushings, tape, and tools.
- [Ramps & Parks](https://fingerboardlab.com/search/ramps-parks): Wooden ramps, rails, ledges, and park sets.
